df["runner_on_base"]=(
df["on_1b"].notna()|
df["on_2b"].notna()|
df["on_3b"].notna())

df["risp"]=(
df["on_2b"].notna()|
df["on_3b"].notna())


df["at_bat_id"] = (
    df["game_date"].astype(str) + "_" +
    df["home_team"] + "_" +
    df["at_bat_number"].astype(str)
)

df["fps"] = np.where(
    (df["balls"] == 0) &
    (df["strikes"] == 0) &
    (df["type"] == "S"),
    "Yes",
    "No"
)

first_pitch = df.groupby("at_bat_id").first()["type"]

df["fps"] = df["at_bat_id"].map(first_pitch == "S")

df


df["pc"] = np.where(
    df["balls"] < df ["strikes"],
    "Yes",
    "No"
)

pitchers_count = df.groupby("at_bat_id")["pc"].apply(
    lambda x: (x == "Yes").any()
)

df["pc"] = df["at_bat_id"].map(pitchers_count)
df["pc"].value_counts()

def out_percentage(results):
    out_events = ["field_out", "strikeout", "grounded_into_double_play", "fielders_choice_out", "force_out", "double_play"]
    total_outs= results.loc()[results.index.isin(out_events),"Frequency"].sum()
    total_results = results["Frequency"].sum()

    if total_results == 0:
        return 0
    
    return total_outs/total_results

results_players = {}

for player in dfq3_tor["player_name"].unique():
    player_df = dfq3_tor[dfq3_tor["player_name"] == player]

    results = {}

    for event in player_df["events"].dropna():
        if event not in results:
            results[event] = 1
        else:
            results[event] += 1

    results_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
        results,
        orient="index",
        columns=["Frequency"]
    )

    results_players[player] = out_percentage(results_df)

results_players_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
    results_players,
    orient="index",
    columns=["Out Percentage"]
)

results_players_df["Frequency"] = dfq3_tor.groupby(
    "player_name"
)["events"].count()


results_players_df = results_players_df.sort_values(
    by="Out Percentage",
    ascending=False
)

print(results_players_df)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

for player, row in results_players_df.iterrows():
    ax.scatter(
        row["Frequency"],
        row["Out Percentage"],
        label=player
    )

ax.set_xlabel("Frequency (At-Bats)")
ax.set_ylabel("Out Percentage")
ax.set_title("Out Percentage vs. Frequency by Player, pitchers counts")

ax.legend(
    title="Player",
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1),
    loc="upper left"
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

        if event not in results_fps:
            results_fps[event] = 1
        else:
            results_fps[event] += 1

    results_df_fps = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
        results_fps,
        orient="index",
        columns=["Frequency"]
    )

    results_players_fps[player] = out_percentage(results_df_fps)

results_players_fps_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
    results_players_fps,
    orient="index",
    columns=["Out Percentage"]
)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Go through each player
for player in results_players_fps_df.index:
    if player in results_players_df.index:

        # Get the player's first-pitch-strike results
        fps_row = results_players_fps_df.loc[player]

        # Get the player's pitcher's-count results
        pc_row = results_players_df.loc[player]

        # Plot the first-pitch-strike point as a circle
        points = ax.scatter(
            fps_row["Frequency"],
            fps_row["Out Percentage"],
            label=player,
            marker="o"
        )

        # Get the colour assigned to that player
        colour = points.get_facecolor()[0]

        # Plot the pitcher's-count point as an x
        # Use the same colour as the player's circle
        ax.scatter(
            pc_row["Frequency"],
            pc_row["Out Percentage"],
            color=colour,
            marker="x"
        )

# Label the axes

ax.set_ylabel("Out Percentage")

    title="Player",

)
